name: Matutinal-Fjard
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait binary sunset (multiple suns), and everything the light never reaches.

The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Fossil beds suggest rich seas once flourished here; now the chemistry records only a slow suffocation.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
Whoever controls exotic matter controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
